Why a bull.

AUROX comes from "aurum," meaning gold, the thing you don't throw away, fused with "ox," an animal that carries the load and doesn't complain about it. That's the whole brand in two syllables.

Every print is treated like the main event, not decoration on a blank shirt.

Built for people who read the back of a shirt before they read the front.

Inspired by the legendary aurochs. Minimal design. Timeless quality.
